commands:
set -eu
echo NODE_AND_BTF
uname -r; test -r /sys/kernel/btf/vmlinux && echo BTF=present; bpftool feature probe kernel 2>&1 | grep -E 'bpf() syscall|map_type ringbuf|program_type tracepoint|prog_type|arch' | head -12 || true
echo LOADED_BPF_PROGRAMS
bpftool prog list 2>&1 | head -40
echo BPF_LINKS
bpftool link list 2>&1 | head -40
echo TARGET_IMAGE_DIGESTS
k3s kubectl get pods -n phantom-eval -o jsonpath='{range .items[*]}{.metadata.name}{"\t"}{.spec.containers[0].image}{"\t"}{.status.containerStatuses[0].imageID}{"\n"}{end}'
echo AGENT_IMAGE_DIGEST
k3s kubectl get pods -n phantom -l app=phantom-ebpf-agent -o jsonpath='{.items[0].status.containerStatuses[0].imageID}'; echo
echo ACTIVE_POLICY_DROP_RULES
iptables-save -c | grep 'DROP by policy phantom-eval/isolate-phantom-eval-egress' || true
